name: NSGA-II Pareto front: DSI vs cytoplasm volume on Bed B + 14-d morph
short_description: Per-cell evaluations from the t0122 68-d NSGA-II run optimising (maximise DSI, minimise cytoplasm volume) on the Bed B + 14-d morphology substrate. Single GA seed; pop=96; N_EVAL_SEEDS=3; N_GEN_MAX=60; HV-plateau auto-stop disabled.
model_description: Procedural Bed B DSGC cell with 14-d morphology parameter space (t0090 generator + t0092 z-axis soma patch) and 54-d electrophys parameter scheme (t0080 NEURON MOD channels). Evaluated under a 2-direction PD-vs-ND protocol with AR(2)-correlated synaptic noise (t0024 de Rosenroll 2026 ports).
prediction_schema: Each row: {vector_68d, dsi_vector_sum, pd_rate_hz, robustness, cytoplasm_volume_um3, objective_F_minimised, silence_failed_bool, legit_bool}. See description.md for full field definitions.

files.description: Gzipped JSONL with one row per unique cell evaluated by the NSGA-II run. See description.md and prediction_schema.
